payload.title: Report: Nintendo slashes Switch 2 production by a third due to weak U.S. sales forecasts
payload.content: Nintendo has reportedly downgraded Switch 2 production from 6 million units to 4 million units, a reduction of roughly one third, due to weaker-than-expected U.S. sales demand. The report comes ahead of the console's launch and suggests Nintendo is taking a more conservative approach following concerns about consumer price sensitivity in the North American market.

signals.signal_label: Switch 2 产量下调三分之一
signals.description: 任天堂据报将 Switch 2 产量从 600 万台下调至 400 万台，下调约三分之一，原因是美国市场需求弱于预期。
